finding.headline: "The Four-Walls Prison"
finding.problem: "I love my baby but I'm suffocating in this flat. I want to walk to the end of the road and I can't make my feet move. I feel like a prisoner in my own home."
finding.person: Mum with severe cabin fever whose anxiety (not laziness) keeps her inside; every attempt to leave ends in panic.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "The Front-Door Protocol: A 7-Day Escape From Cabin Fever (Baby in Tow)."". Verdict: PASSES.
